windowRules.ttm: Four consecutive DISCRETE_QUARTER observations. Q2 and Q3 may use adjacent YTD differences; Q4 may use the separately versioned strict fiscal-year annual minus nine-month YTD rule.
windowRules.weightedShares: Four discrete-quarter diluted weighted-average share facts weighted by inclusive duration days.
windowRules.threeYear: Current and prior four-quarter windows have period ends 1,000 through 1,200 days apart.
windowRules.stability: Eight consecutive period-aligned discrete quarters across operating income, revenue, operating cash flow, and capex.
windowRules.cutoffRule: availableAt must be at or before cutoff.
windowRules.fiscalCalendarRule: Date continuity permits proven 53/54-week fiscal calendars. Q4 derivation rejects annual durations outside 350-385 days.
